verdict.rationale: GitHub's docs say you can access and write data in repositories over SSH using key-based authentication. They also cover cloning with standard Git and adding remotes with `git remote add`. Community reports of users running `git push -u origin master` and being rejected (because the default branch is `main`) confirm that standard Git clients push to GitHub. missing for 10: explicit documentation of HTTPS transport and credential setup, explicit coverage of pull/fetch, and independent confirmation of compatibility with arbitrary third-party Git clients.
